02 • CORE ARCHITECTURE & SCALE

Turning One Giant Problem Into Parallel Tasks

System-Level Computing
01 / LOCAL
Laptop

4–16 cores, local RAM. Built for small tables & prototyping.

Sequential Limit
02 / SINGLE NODE
AI Workstation

32–128 cores, 1–4 local GPUs. Medium deep learning runs.

Single-Box Ceiling
03 / CLUSTER HPC
Lab / Cloud HPC

Hundreds of coupled nodes, Slurm scheduler, shared storage.

Elastic Parallelism
04 / EXTREME HPC
Supercomputer

Millions of CPU/GPU cores across ultra-fast interconnects.

ExaFLOP Scale
Why Parallelism Wins: The 1,000-File Analogy
1 WORKER (SEQUENTIAL)

Processes 1,000 files one by one in a single slow queue.

100 NODES (PARALLEL HPC)

100 workers process 10 files each at the exact same moment.

JUNE 2026 #1 TOP500 SYSTEM LineShine
2.198 EFLOP/s
13,789,440 Parallel Compute Cores

05 • PARADIGM SHIFT IN ANALYTICS

Single-Machine vs. HPC Data Science

Architectural Evolution
Dimension Traditional Computing HPC-Enabled Data Science
1. Compute Scale Single workstation or server Hundreds to millions of cores
2. Processor Mix CPU-dominant serial execution CPU + GPU / AI accelerator clusters
3. Memory & Data Limited by local RAM & disk Distributed memory & parallel storage
4. Job Execution Manual interactive runs Automated Slurm scheduler queues
5. Deployment Fixed local hardware box On-prem + Cloud HPC + Hybrid

Hyperion Taxonomy Update (2025): HPC and AI servers have converged—modern clusters run both physics simulations and foundation AI models.

HPC + AI Convergence
Sources: Hyperion Research "Updated View of the HPC/AI Market" (June 2025) Slide 05 / 12
06 • REAL-WORLD IMPACT

4 Domains Transformed by Extreme Compute

Science & Industry
01 • Weather & Climate (ECMWF)

15-Day Global AI Forecast in Minutes

120 GH200 GPUs

ECMWF’s operational AI Forecasting System runs on a 30-node × 4 NVIDIA GH200 GPU cluster, combining dedicated supercomputing with cloud collaboration.

02 • Healthcare & Biology (ORNL)

Generative Protein & Drug Design

Frontier Exascale

Trained on ORNL’s Frontier to design custom antibodies, vaccines, cancer therapies, and enzymes by pairing molecular physics with generative AI.

03 • Precision Agriculture (ORNL)

High-Dimensional Plant Imaging

-75% Memory

New Frontier algorithm cuts memory usage by up to 75% and achieves >2× faster processing across massive plant phenotype and climate datasets.

04 • Energy & Industrial CAE

CFD, Fusion & Digital Engineering

Billions of Cells

Powers full-resolution aerodynamic fluid dynamics, fusion plasma modeling, and seismic energy exploration—replacing costly physical prototypes.

03

Real-World Impact

Speaker Notes & Sources — Slide 01: Title & Introduction
Presenter Notes

Begin by resolving the terminology. Explain that 'H-Computing' is most accurately presented as High-Performance Computing, or HPC. Rather than thinking of HPC as one giant computer, think of it as an architecture that coordinates huge amounts of compute, memory, networking and storage so that difficult problems can be divided and solved simultaneously.

Transition Cue: “So before looking at companies or markets, we need a precise understanding of what HPC actually is.”
